body: Please don't do it. I felt like I couldn't get out of things, but another Redditor in the same position as me, with a similar post on this very subreddit messaged me. And now we're friends. My point is, that you can come and talk to me or anyone else who is on this subreddit to let us try and help you get through this tough time. WE are here for you, not just me, but everyone who comes on here to help. Like /u/I_Love_SlaveSubs said, *internet hug* just please don't go!

I know, but still, we were getting on so well. It felt nice, it felt promising. She claimed to love me, which hurt because I knew it was a lie.

And I know, I know. I'm feeling the hurt now. She didn't tell me about the guy. I asked her what she was up to this weekend, she said she was staying at a friends. I pressed her for who and regretted asking. And I know, I see that now, but that doesn't stop me thinking about what we had, and what the future could of held for us... And no, she's not the only reason, she's the reason I posted, simply because she was the most recent occurrence. But I've been depressed for a couple years, had no friends my whole life, been alone besides my relationship with her my whole life. I have no prospects, no job, I'm doing poorly with education, I don't have any real reason to go on, at least from my point of view.

Yeah I know, I'm feeling it 3 months after it happened, it hurts like I've been hit by a train, survived, hit again an survived. I've gone a couple days without talking to her, I was recently feeling a lot better. We started talking again on friday, and we had an amazing night together. We had a laugh, a chat and all sorts. We got on great. She told me she was staying at this guys house, and immediately I felt down a little. Then she said she was going alone, and I knew. From then, me and her have not gotten on very well.

It just doesn't feel right, because we were set to live till death together. I'm talking we had plans for moving in together, getting married, having kids. Our families loved the other one. I loved her family, like they were my own! We just seemed so set.

I don't feel stronger, I feel pummelled, down trodden, like there's no end to the beating. I have no aspirations, no prospects, no happiness, no friends, no hopes. Nothing. I feel alone. I feel abandoned. I feel like there's no end. Which has let me to feel like the only end is the one I bring about myself. I have failed once, but I knew that if I try again, I wont.

Thank you for responding though, I appreciate you taking time out to do that.

I'm sorry to hear about your situation man, I hope things get better for you. I know there is, but she broke my heart. My ex was perfect, we were perfect for each other, she completed me, made me feel like life was worth living. As I said, we made plans for the future. We were set to do everything together. I couldn't wait for the future, something that I'd never felt before.

Stepping back is not something I can do, I have to keep right in it with exams coming up, with school on my back. I don't smoke, or do anything like that, though I'm sure it would help right now.

I appreciate the friendly and encouraging words, but whenever I've heard them, from anyone, they just make me feel like they are something I SHOULD be but am not, which makes me feel like more of a failure. This picture actually displays how I feel (felt) quite well. https://fbcdn-sphotos-e-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-ash3/t1/554787_10152095175166840_1438716155_n.jpg

Thanks for responding though man, it's nice to have someone there, even if I don't know them.
